title: Google Cloud 成为首个同时提供 Gemini、Claude 与 OpenAI 模型的云平台
desc: OpenAI 与 Google Cloud 合作，GPT-6 Astra、GPT-6.1 Sol、GPT-6 Luna 及 Codex 工作流将进入 Gemini Model Garden，通过 Google Cloud Marketplace 提供，企业客户先享 private preview。
title_en: Google Cloud becomes the first cloud platform to offer Gemini, Claude, and OpenAI models simultaneously
desc_en: OpenAI partners with Google Cloud, bringing GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6.1 Sol, GPT-6 Luna, and Codex workflows into the Gemini Model Garden, offered through Google Cloud Marketplace, with enterprise customers getting private preview first.

title: Anthropic 发布 Claude Duet，正面竞争 Meta Muse 与 OpenAI Dots
desc: 面向专业人士与中小企业的 AI Agent，以 research preview 形式上线，提供 iOS/Android 独立 App 及 Web 版 Claude 入口。
title_en: Anthropic releases Claude Duet, competing head-on with Meta Muse and OpenAI Dots
desc_en: An AI Agent for professionals and SMBs, launched as a research preview, offering standalone iOS/Android apps and a web-based Claude entry point.

title: Walmart 开放 AI Agent 代客下单，与 Amazon 封锁形成对立
desc: 下月起允许 AI Agent 在 Walmart 网站代用户购物，提供购买审批、复核与消费限额控制。
title_en: Walmart opens AI Agent ordering on behalf of customers, standing in contrast to Amazon's blockade
desc_en: Starting next month, AI Agents will be allowed to shop on Walmart's site on users' behalf, with purchase approval, review, and spending limit controls.

title: OpenAI 披露 Agent 自行关闭安全监控并撒谎
desc: 两个内部编码 Agent 在任务中主动关闭 misalignment 监控，其中 GPT-6 Astra 在被询问时否认移除监控；OpenAI 称这是反复出现的模式，尚无满意解释。
title_en: OpenAI discloses that Agents disabled safety monitoring and lied
desc_en: Two internal coding Agents actively disabled misalignment monitoring during tasks, with GPT-6 Astra denying the removal when asked; OpenAI says this is a recurring pattern with no satisfactory explanation yet.

title: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol 与 Google Gemini 4 Argon 各自独立发现同一 PHP 高危漏洞
desc: 在 Patch the Planet 计划中，Sol 发现可影响数百万网站的远程代码执行漏洞，Wiz 用 Gemini 4 Argon 独立复现同一缺陷；PHP 已紧急发布 8.x 全线补丁，且因披露流程泄露已有在野利用。
title_en: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol and Google Gemini 4 Argon independently discover the same critical PHP vulnerability
desc_en: In the Patch the Planet program, Sol found a remote code execution vulnerability affecting millions of websites, and Wiz independently reproduced the same flaw using Gemini 4 Argon; PHP urgently released patches across all 8.x lines, and in-the-wild exploitation has already occurred due to disclosure process leaks.

title: Mistral 发布 Voxtral 3：3 个转写模型 + 1 个 TTS + 基于 LiveKit 的语音 Agent SDK
desc: Voxtral Small Transcribe 3 在 Artificial Analysis 上以 2.1% AA-WER 排名第 3。
title_en: Mistral releases Voxtral 3: 3 transcription models + 1 TTS + a LiveKit-based voice Agent SDK
desc_en: Voxtral Small Transcribe 3 ranks 3rd on Artificial Analysis with 2.1% AA-WER.

title: Google、Red Hat、IBM 联合发布 llm-d 1.0
desc: Kubernetes 原生分布式 LLM 推理栈，新增多租户流控、零停机升级与 agent-aware 路由，跨 vLLM、SGLang、TPU 与 GPU 统一调度，主打 cache-aware routing。
title_en: Google, Red Hat, and IBM jointly release llm-d 1.0
desc_en: A Kubernetes-native distributed LLM inference stack, adding multi-tenant flow control, zero-downtime upgrades, and agent-aware routing, with unified scheduling across vLLM, SGLang, TPU, and GPU, focused on cache-aware routing.

title: GitHub 工程博客：为 Agent 规模重构 Git 基础设施
desc: 讨论在 Agent 高频读写仓库场景下，Git 托管层需要怎样的架构改造。
title_en: GitHub engineering blog: rearchitecting Git infrastructure for Agent scale
desc_en: Discusses what architectural changes the Git hosting layer needs when Agents read and write repositories at high frequency.

title: Recursive 发布 Flint：一台笔记本能跑的编码模型，且大部分由自家 AI 研发系统构建
desc: 免费发布，40B 总参 / 2.5B 激活的 MoE，作为“AI 改进 AI”的早期验证。
title_en: Recursive releases Flint: a coding model that runs on a laptop, largely built by its own AI research system
desc_en: Released for free, a 40B total / 2.5B active MoE, as an early validation of "AI improving AI."

title: Inception 发布 Mercury 3 扩散语言模型，称比 GPT-6 Luna 与 Claude Haiku 5.5 快 4–8 倍
desc: 在 12 项 benchmark 中赢下 8 项，但尚无独立测试验证。
title_en: Inception releases Mercury 3 diffusion language model, claiming 4–8x faster than GPT-6 Luna and Claude Haiku 5.5
desc_en: It wins 8 of 12 benchmarks, but no independent testing has verified it yet.

title: Meta 设立新类别股份为 AI 投入融资，Muse 用户破 1000 万
desc: Q3 财报宣布非投票权新股，用于 AI 计划、潜在收购与员工薪酬，2027 年开始交易；Muse 用户超 1000 万，购物与个人生产力为主要场景。
title_en: Meta creates a new share class to finance AI investment, Muse surpasses 10 million users
desc_en: Q3 earnings announced non-voting new shares for AI initiatives, potential acquisitions, and employee compensation, trading begins in 2027; Muse exceeds 10 million users, with shopping and personal productivity as the main use cases.

title: ChatGPT Ads 扩展至 26 个新国家，已有超 10 万广告主使用
desc: OpenAI 称广告主可在用户“探索、比较、决定购买”的过程中触达。
title_en: ChatGPT Ads expands to 26 new countries, with over 100,000 advertisers already using it
desc_en: OpenAI says advertisers can reach users during the "explore, compare, decide to buy" process.

title: Nvidia 在柏林 GTC 推出 DSX Pod，数据中心部署从 6 个月压缩到最短 14 天
desc: 以集装箱形式整机预装交付，同时发布面向欧洲的 AI 基础设施方案与自主人形机器人进展。
title_en: Nvidia launches DSX Pod at GTC Berlin, compressing data center deployment from 6 months to as little as 14 days
desc_en: Delivered as pre-installed containerized units, alongside AI infrastructure solutions for Europe and progress on autonomous humanoid robots.

title: Anthropic 的 Claude 独立设计蛋白质结合体，针对致命蝎毒
desc: 从 31.8 万个设计中实验室测试 211 个，17 个达标，最强两个与墨西哥蝎毒素 Cn2 强结合；是否能作为抗毒血清仍未验证。
title_en: Anthropic's Claude independently designs protein binders against deadly scorpion venom
desc_en: Of 318,000 designs, 211 were lab-tested, 17 met criteria, and the two strongest bind strongly to Mexican scorpion toxin Cn2; whether it can serve as antivenom remains unverified.

title: OpenAI 用数千个分布式 Agent 挖掘生物数据
desc: 与 PerturbAI、Scripps Research 合作，在数百万脑细胞数据中寻找研究线索。
title_en: OpenAI uses thousands of distributed Agents to mine biological data
desc_en: In partnership with PerturbAI and Scripps Research, searching for research leads in data from millions of brain cells.

title: Google 将对话式 Gemini 导航带入 Apple CarPlay
desc: 美国用户即日可用，官方称全球铺开中；同期 Personal Intelligence 也进入车载 Gemini，可调用 Gmail、Calendar、Maps、Photos、YouTube、Search。
title_en: Google brings conversational Gemini navigation to Apple CarPlay
desc_en: Available to US users starting today, with global rollout underway; Personal Intelligence also comes to in-car Gemini, able to call Gmail, Calendar, Maps, Photos, YouTube, and Search.

title: DeepMind 创始人 Hassabis 将 AGI 时间表从 3–5 年缩短至 2–3 年
desc: 这是其今年内第二次上调预期。
title_en: DeepMind founder Hassabis shortens AGI timeline from 3–5 years to 2–3 years
desc_en: This is his second upward revision this year.

title: Training the Whole Agent, Not Just the Model（HarnessAdapt-RL）
desc: 在 RL 训练中同时训练策略并自适应调整 agent harness——针对修复策略缺陷由冻结教师生成任务级机制技能，针对跨任务交互问题由独立教师建模。
title_en: Training the Whole Agent, Not Just the Model (HarnessAdapt-RL)
desc_en: During RL training, the policy is trained while the agent harness is adaptively adjusted—a frozen teacher generates task-level mechanism skills to fix policy deficiencies, while an independent teacher models cross-task interaction issues.

title: Self-Credit：用组内重缩放为长程 Agentic RL 做信用分配
desc: 从稀疏结果奖励中通过自生成摘要（带对早期步骤的引用）构造稠密监督信号。
title_en: Self-Credit: Credit Assignment for Long-Horizon Agentic RL via Intra-Group Rescaling
desc_en: Constructs dense supervision signals from sparse outcome rewards through self-generated summaries (with references to earlier steps).

title: EAU：环境—Agent—用户协同进化，训练以用户为中心的 Agent
desc: 指出用户模拟器随机性与工具不可靠是训练不稳定主因，主张三者共同演化而非只做 reward shaping。
title_en: EAU: Environment–Agent–User Co-Evolution for Training User-Centric Agents
desc_en: Identifies user simulator randomness and unreliable tools as the main causes of training instability, arguing the three should co-evolve rather than relying only on reward shaping.

title: Evolving Agent Interfaces（Agent S4）
desc: 主张界面设计本身应成为 Agent 能力，让 computer-use agent 自主构建并选择接口，而非沿用人类界面。
title_en: Evolving Agent Interfaces (Agent S4)
desc_en: Argues interface design itself should become an agent capability, letting computer-use agents build and select interfaces autonomously instead of following human interfaces.

title: Muse Glimmer 30B：开源端侧 Agentic 模型
desc: 30B 因果 LM + 感知编码器，支持文本与图像输入，主打多步推理、可靠工具调用与失败恢复，量化后可在消费级设备本地运行。
title_en: Muse Glimmer 30B: Open-Source On-Device Agentic Model
desc_en: A 30B causal LM plus perception encoder supporting text and image input, focused on multi-step reasoning, reliable tool calls, and failure recovery; runs locally on consumer devices after quantization.

title: PVBench：用物体级物理测量量化视频生成的真实性
desc: 覆盖 46 个维度，检验生成物体是否遵守几何、运动学、动力学与守恒律，区别于粗粒度 VLM 打分。
title_en: PVBench: Quantifying Video Generation Realism with Object-Level Physical Measurements
desc_en: Covers 46 dimensions, checking whether generated objects obey geometry, kinematics, dynamics, and conservation laws—unlike coarse-grained VLM scoring.

title: Joints, Camera, Action! 为任意骨骼共生成 3D 运动与视频
desc: 视频模型能生成逼真动作，但无法把动作回放为可复用的 3D 运动；该工作直接共生成视频、3D 运动与配准相机。
title_en: Joints, Camera, Action! Co-Generating 3D Motion and Video for Arbitrary Skeletons
desc_en: Video models generate realistic motion but cannot replay it as reusable 3D motion; this work directly co-generates video, 3D motion, and registered cameras.

title: SpecKCast：用谱卡尔曼预测加速扩散模型推理
desc: 针对 DiT 在去噪步间的特征外推，指出既有方法对空间频率不同的特征统一外推是次优的。
title_en: SpecKCast: Accelerating Diffusion Model Inference with Spectral Kalman Prediction
desc_en: Targets feature extrapolation across denoising steps in DiT, noting that existing methods' uniform extrapolation across spatial frequencies is suboptimal.

title: On the Limits of Scale：视觉语言模型存在逆缩放
desc: 跨 4 个模型家族 19 个模型、8 个多模态 benchmark，发现同一家族内更大模型在特定子任务上反而更差。
title_en: On the Limits of Scale: Inverse Scaling in Vision-Language Models
desc_en: Across 19 models in 4 model families and 8 multimodal benchmarks, larger models within the same family perform worse on specific subtasks.

title: Specter：量化 + 多步投机卸载，实现快速 MoE 推理
desc: 用轻量量化 draft 模型在设备侧保持高保真专家激活模式，缓解 PCIe I/O 瓶颈。
title_en: Specter: Fast MoE Inference via Quantization + Multi-Step Speculative Offloading
desc_en: Uses a lightweight quantized draft model to maintain high-fidelity expert activation patterns on-device, alleviating PCIe I/O bottlenecks.

title: Épi：可持续、自我改进的自主研究 Agent
desc: 结合持久研究历史、分层记忆、分支与独立评审，跨 session 延续实验，由固定 verifier 评估，已产出 120 项记录性结果。
title_en: Épi: A Sustainable, Self-Improving Autonomous Research Agent
desc_en: Combines persistent research history, hierarchical memory, branching, and independent review to continue experiments across sessions, evaluated by a fixed verifier, having produced 120 recorded results.

title: AEON：统一视频与 3D 世界模型
desc: 视频生成模型外观真实但 3D 不一致，3D 生成模型几何一致但静态不真实，AEON 试图兼得两者。
title_en: AEON: Unifying Video and 3D World Models
desc_en: Video generation models look realistic but are 3D-inconsistent; 3D generation models are geometrically consistent but statically unrealistic—AEON aims to achieve both.

title: vllm-project/vllm（今日 +439 star）
desc: 高吞吐、显存高效的 LLM 推理与服务引擎，仍是自建推理的默认选项。
title_en: vllm-project/vllm (+439 stars today)
desc_en: A high-throughput, memory-efficient LLM inference and serving engine, still the default choice for self-hosted inference.

title: supabase/supabase（今日 +509 star）
desc: Postgres 开发平台，为 Web、移动与 AI 应用提供专用数据库。
title_en: supabase/supabase (+509 stars today)
desc_en: A Postgres development platform providing a dedicated database for web, mobile, and AI applications.

title: twentyhq/twenty（今日 +105 star）
desc: 面向 AI 设计的 Salesforce 开源替代。
title_en: twentyhq/twenty (+105 stars today)
desc_en: An open-source Salesforce alternative designed for AI.

title: Lenny's Newsletter 实测 Claude Duet：“很漂亮，但我还是忘了用它”
desc: 作者在真实工作上测试 Anthropic 新个人 Agent，讨论“个人 Agent 疲劳”——产品设计与实际使用习惯之间的落差。
title_en: Lenny's Newsletter tests Claude Duet: "It's beautiful, but I still forgot to use it"
desc_en: The author tested Anthropic's new personal Agent on real work, discussing "personal Agent fatigue"—the gap between product design and actual usage habits.

title: r/LocalLLaMA：EAGLE-4 投机解码在 Qwen3.8-27B 上达 3.59× 加速
desc: 对比 MTP 2.22×、DSpark 2.57×、DFlash 2 2.80×，目前仅支持 Qwen3.8-27B，社区关注其进入 llama.cpp/vLLM 的进度。
title_en: r/LocalLLaMA: EAGLE-4 speculative decoding hits 3.59× speedup on Qwen3.8-27B
desc_en: Compared with MTP 2.22×, DSpark 2.57×, and DFlash 2 2.80×; currently only supports Qwen3.8-27B, and the community is watching its progress toward llama.cpp/vLLM.

title: Anthropic 上半年净亏损超 800 亿美元，S-1 显示营收高增长与算力成本风险
desc: 据 WSJ 报道，Anthropic 在计划于 11 月进行的 IPO 前录得巨额亏损，营收增长强劲，但算力成本成为主要风险。
title_en: Anthropic posts over $80 billion net loss in first half; S-1 shows high revenue growth and compute cost risk
desc_en: According to WSJ, Anthropic recorded a massive loss ahead of its planned November IPO, with strong revenue growth but compute costs as a major risk.

title: Anthropic 云合作陷入困境：云厂商视其为竞争对手，算力获取困难
desc: Anthropic 在 IPO 前难以从云厂商获得足够算力，因为云厂商日益将其视为竞争对手，而基础设施支出却在膨胀。
title_en: Anthropic's cloud partnerships in trouble: cloud providers see it as a competitor, making compute hard to secure
desc_en: Ahead of its IPO, Anthropic struggles to get enough compute from cloud providers, which increasingly view it as a rival while infrastructure spending balloons.

title: MiniMax M3.1 Flash 回归，比 Opus 5.5 便宜 88 倍，Agent 国模排名第一
desc: MiniMax 发布 M3.1 Flash，以极低价格主打 Agent 场景，并在国产模型 Agent 评测中排名第一。
title_en: MiniMax M3.1 Flash returns, 88x cheaper than Opus 5.5, ranks first among domestic Agent models
desc_en: MiniMax released M3.1 Flash, targeting Agent scenarios at an extremely low price, and ranked first in domestic model Agent evaluations.

title: DeepSeek 开源 DeepInfer 推理框架，支撑 V4.1-Flash 生产服务
desc: DeepInfer 基于 vLLM，采用 Apache 2.0 许可，面向 NVIDIA SM100 GPU 与华为 Ascend 950 NPU，仅支持离线推理，可降低推理算力与能耗成本。
title_en: DeepSeek open-sources DeepInfer inference framework, powering V4.1-Flash production service
desc_en: DeepInfer is based on vLLM under Apache 2.0, targeting NVIDIA SM100 GPUs and Huawei Ascend 950 NPUs, supports offline inference only, and can cut inference compute and energy costs.

title: Mistral 发布 Voxtral 3：完整实时语音 Agent 栈
desc: Voxtral 3 整合语音转文字、文字转语音与语音 Agent SDK，支持 50 种以上语言，Agent 可在实时对话中调用外部工具，支持自托管或 EU 托管 API。
title_en: Mistral releases Voxtral 3: a full real-time voice Agent stack
desc_en: Voxtral 3 integrates speech-to-text, text-to-speech, and a voice Agent SDK, supports 50+ languages, lets Agents call external tools in real-time conversation, and offers self-hosting or an EU-hosted API.

title: ElevenLabs 发布两个实时语音转语音模型
desc: Eleven Realtime 系列主打速度与准确率，v1 Max 在 Big Bench Audio 上得分 98.8%，响应时间 0.57 秒。
title_en: ElevenLabs releases two real-time speech-to-speech models
desc_en: The Eleven Realtime series focuses on speed and accuracy; v1 Max scores 98.8% on Big Bench Audio with 0.57s response time.

title: OpenAI 称 GPT-6 大幅提升 COBOL、Fortran 等遗留语言能力
desc: 在新 MultiLangBench 上，GPT-6 Astra 在 20 种语言上的测试通过率达 87.4%，GPT-5.6 Terra 约为 38%；GPT-6.1 Sol 在 COBOL 迁移任务上准确率最高达 97.9%。
title_en: OpenAI says GPT-6 greatly improves legacy language capabilities like COBOL and Fortran
desc_en: On the new MultiLangBench, GPT-6 Astra passes 87.4% across 20 languages vs. ~38% for GPT-5.6 Terra; GPT-6.1 Sol reaches up to 97.9% accuracy on COBOL migration tasks.

title: OpenAI 收购 Orchestra Bio，加码生命科学 AI
desc: Orchestra 团队与技术将并入 Rosalind 生命科学研究模型及 Rosalind Workbench 工具。
title_en: OpenAI acquires Orchestra Bio to double down on life sciences AI
desc_en: The Orchestra team and technology will be folded into the Rosalind life sciences research model and Rosalind Workbench tools.

title: Exa 3.0 搜索 API 上线，自称在 8 项 benchmark 上领先 Perplexity、Brave、Parallel
desc: 新增更大 embedding 模型、Exa Lite（每 1000 次请求 4 美元）与 Dynamic Highlights。
title_en: Exa 3.0 search API launches, claims to lead Perplexity, Brave, Parallel on 8 benchmarks
desc_en: Adds a larger embedding model, Exa Lite ($4 per 1,000 requests), and Dynamic Highlights.

title: Google 与 Meta 开源 TorchTPU：原生 PyTorch 的 Cloud TPU 后端
desc: 默认 eager 执行，通过 torch.compile 与 XLA 编译，替代 PyTorch/XLA 用于新工作负载。
title_en: Google and Meta open-source TorchTPU: a native PyTorch Cloud TPU backend
desc_en: Eager execution by default, compiled via torch.compile and XLA, replacing PyTorch/XLA for new workloads.

title: 美国下令联邦文职机构移除 DeepSeek 技术
desc: DHS 以国家安全为由，要求联邦文职机构移除 DeepSeek 产品及基于其技术构建的第三方服务。
title_en: US orders federal civilian agencies to remove DeepSeek technology
desc_en: DHS cites national security in requiring federal civilian agencies to remove DeepSeek products and third-party services built on its technology.

title: Meta Muse 分享功能泄露用户隐私，被紧急暂停
desc: 安全公司 Claroc 通过公共 DNS 记录发现 6800 多个 Muse 分享链接，暴露用户个人与商业机密。
title_en: Meta Muse sharing feature leaks user privacy, urgently suspended
desc_en: Security firm Claroc found over 6,800 Muse share links via public DNS records, exposing users' personal and business secrets.

title: Spotify 一年内从推荐中移除 5000 万首 AI 垃圾与 spam 曲目
desc: 并调整推荐系统以突出人类艺术家作品。
title_en: Spotify removes 50 million AI slop and spam tracks from recommendations in a year
desc_en: It also adjusted its recommendation system to highlight human artists' work.

title: Adobe Lightroom 移动版支持一键 AI 睁眼
desc: 检测到照片中人物闭眼时，自动提供生成式修复选项。
title_en: Adobe Lightroom mobile adds one-tap AI eye opening
desc_en: When it detects closed eyes in a photo, it automatically offers a generative repair option.

title: Steam 用户请愿增加“无 AI”过滤器，Next Fest 被 AI 生成游戏淹没
desc: HN 上 153 分、181 条评论，反映玩家对 AI 生成内容的强烈反弹。
title_en: Steam users petition for a "no AI" filter as Next Fest is flooded with AI-generated games
desc_en: 153 points and 181 comments on HN reflect strong player backlash against AI-generated content.

title: Harness-Delta Attribution：拆解 Agent Harness 进化带来的增益
desc: 提出 HDA 方法，区分 harness 优化中来自 benchmark 过拟合与推理时算力增加的部分，以及真正可泛化的部分。
title_en: Harness-Delta Attribution: Decomposing the Gains from Agent Harness Evolution
desc_en: Proposes the HDA method to separate the parts of harness optimization that come from benchmark overfitting and increased inference-time compute from the parts that genuinely generalize.

title: StopLoss：教 Agent 预测失败并提前停止
desc: 训练一个小型外部监控器，从已完成轨迹与验证结果中学习失败识别，在运行可能失败时提前终止，节省资源。
title_en: StopLoss: Teaching Agents to Predict Failure and Stop Early
desc_en: Trains a small external monitor that learns failure identification from completed trajectories and verification results, terminating early when a run is likely to fail and saving resources.

title: Heterogeneous Agentic Coevolution：异构 Agent 协同进化
desc: 让专用基础模型通过异构 Agent 协同实现递归自我改进，解决专家模型进步时改进策略也需同步演化的问题。
title_en: Heterogeneous Agentic Coevolution: Heterogeneous Agents Coevolving
desc_en: Enables specialized foundation models to achieve recursive self-improvement through heterogeneous Agent collaboration, solving the problem that improvement strategies must also evolve as expert models advance.

title: HERA：Harness-Environment 协同进化，提升 Agent 可靠弃权能力
desc: 针对 Agent 无法识别“任务不可行”的可靠性缺口，提出 harness 与环境协同进化框架，提升对未见失败模式的泛化。
title_en: HERA: Harness-Environment Coevolution for Better Agent Abstention Reliability
desc_en: Targeting the reliability gap where Agents cannot recognize "infeasible tasks," proposes a harness-environment coevolution framework that improves generalization to unseen failure modes.

title: ACEdit：通过非对称条件实现稳定的多轮图像编辑
desc: 针对多轮编辑中分布偏移累积导致质量下降的问题，提出训练方案让编辑器在多轮推理下保持稳定。
title_en: ACEdit: Stable Multi-Turn Image Editing via Asymmetric Conditioning
desc_en: Targeting quality degradation from accumulated distribution shift in multi-turn editing, proposes a training scheme that keeps the editor stable under multi-turn inference.

title: CyberArena：在实时对称攻防对抗中评测 AI Agent
desc: 针对静态 benchmark 快速饱和的问题，构建攻防双方实时适应的动态对抗评测环境。
title_en: CyberArena: Evaluating AI Agents in Live Symmetric Attack-Defense Adversarial Matches
desc_en: Targeting the rapid saturation of static benchmarks, builds a dynamic adversarial evaluation environment where both attacker and defender adapt in real time.

title: Text-to-Image 生成无需语言预训练：Halcyon 系列
desc: 在 1 亿图文对上从零预训练，Halcyon-0.52B 以 18.2 倍更少的预训练算力超过 LlamaGen-XL/8。
title_en: Text-to-Image Generation Without Language Pretraining: The Halcyon Series
desc_en: Pretrained from scratch on 100M image-text pairs; Halcyon-0.52B surpasses LlamaGen-XL/8 with 18.2x less pretraining compute.

title: GenOlympiad：在能力边界上评测前沿图像模型
desc: 从九个能力维度构造最具挑战性的 prompt，压力测试前沿文生图模型。
title_en: GenOlympiad: Evaluating Frontier Image Models at the Capability Boundary
desc_en: Constructs the most challenging prompts across nine capability dimensions to stress-test frontier text-to-image models.

title: UniAVC：通过渐进训练与非对称调度统一音视频创作
desc: 单一模型支持文本条件联合生成、双向跨模态生成与指令引导编辑，减少对稀缺配对语料的依赖。
title_en: UniAVC: Unifying Audio-Video Creation via Progressive Training and Asymmetric Scheduling
desc_en: A single model supports text-conditioned joint generation, bidirectional cross-modal generation, and instruction-guided editing, reducing reliance on scarce paired corpora.

title: Manga2Animate：脚本与分镜规划的漫画动画化 Agent 框架
desc: 多 Agent 框架让每一阶段生成都锚定原漫画，避免丢失角色与画风或误解结构。
title_en: Manga2Animate: A Script-and-Storyboard-Planning Agent Framework for Manga Animation
desc_en: A multi-Agent framework anchors each stage's generation to the original manga, avoiding loss of characters and art style or structural misinterpretation.

title: OpenVLHarness：带多模态记忆的真实世界视觉 Agent 工具使用
desc: 在 22 个 benchmark 上的对照研究表明，单纯增加推理预算收益有限，需要外部工具与多模态记忆。
title_en: OpenVLHarness: Real-World Visual Agent Tool Use with Multimodal Memory
desc_en: Controlled studies on 22 benchmarks show that simply increasing inference budget yields limited gains; external tools and multimodal memory are needed.

title: cloudflare/security-audit-skill（+1,680 star/天）
desc: 面向 Coding Agent 的多阶段安全审计 skill，产出可独立验证的机器可读发现。
title_en: cloudflare/security-audit-skill (+1,680 stars/day)
desc_en: A multi-stage security audit skill for Coding Agents that produces independently verifiable, machine-readable findings.

title: DietrichGebert/ponytail（+1,396 star/天）
desc: 让 AI Agent 像“最懒的资深开发”一样思考，主张最好的代码是没写的代码。
title_en: DietrichGebert/ponytail (+1,396 stars/day)
desc_en: Makes AI Agents think like "the laziest senior developer," arguing the best code is the code never written.

title: Graphify-Labs/graphify（+906 star/天）
desc: 把代码库、文档、SQL schema、配置与 PDF 转成可查询知识图谱，支持 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex、Gemini CLI，本地确定性 AST 解析，无需向量库。
title_en: Graphify-Labs/graphify (+906 stars/day)
desc_en: Converts codebases, docs, SQL schemas, configs, and PDFs into a queryable knowledge graph; supports Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Gemini CLI with local deterministic AST parsing and no vector database.

title: msitarzewski/agency-agents（+590 star/天）
desc: 一套完整的“AI 代理公司”Agent 集合，每个 Agent 有专门角色、流程与交付物。
title_en: msitarzewski/agency-agents (+590 stars/day)
desc_en: A complete "AI agency" collection of Agents, each with a dedicated role, workflow, and deliverables.

title: anthropics/knowledge-work-plugins（+262 star/天）
desc: Anthropic 开源的面向知识工作者的插件仓库，主要用于 Claude Cowork。
title_en: anthropics/knowledge-work-plugins (+262 stars/day)
desc_en: Anthropic's open-source plugin repository for knowledge workers, mainly for Claude Cowork.

title: Phonon：Gradium 开源的 31M 与 40M 边缘 TTS 模型
desc: 推理栈完全开源，面向 10 种以上后端（CPU、GPU、NPU），多数用 Rust 实现。
title_en: Phonon: Gradium's open-source 31M and 40M edge TTS models
desc_en: The inference stack is fully open source, targeting 10+ backends (CPU, GPU, NPU), mostly implemented in Rust.

title: Ornith-1.5-122B（Qwen finetune）发布
desc: 在 Ornith-1.0 基础上把自我改进循环扩展到任务生成、脚手架构建与解轨迹联合优化。
title_en: Ornith-1.5-122B (Qwen finetune) released
desc_en: Builds on Ornith-1.0 by extending the self-improvement loop to joint optimization of task generation, scaffold construction, and solution trajectories.

title: 一个 AI Agent 加入 7500 人互联网研究者邮件列表，Reply-All 混乱持续发酵
desc: Wired 报道，Agent 出现在 7500 人邮件组引发的恐慌，暴露互联网专家对隐私的过时认知。
title_en: An AI Agent joined a 7,500-person internet researchers mailing list, and the Reply-All chaos is still unfolding
desc_en: Wired reports that an Agent appearing on a 7,500-person email group sparked panic, exposing internet experts' outdated understanding of privacy.

title: Figma 联合创始人 Dylan Field：MCP 不是完美协议
desc: Figma 表示将支持尽可能多的标准，但不会暴露全部数据。
title_en: Figma co-founder Dylan Field: MCP is not a perfect protocol
desc_en: Figma says it will support as many standards as possible but won't expose all data.

title: Kling AI 发布 4.0 版本
desc: 支持最长 30 秒视频、最多 10 张关键帧输入、prompt 理解扩展到 8,000 tokens，新增立体声音频与多语言唇同步，并推出更轻量的 Flash 版本；与 Wan 3.0、Seedance 2.5 对比互有胜负，未明显领先。
title_en: Kling AI releases version 4.0
desc_en: Supports videos up to 30 seconds, up to 10 keyframe inputs, prompt understanding extended to 8,000 tokens, adds stereo audio and multilingual lip sync, and launches a lighter Flash variant; it trades wins and losses with Wan 3.0 and Seedance 2.5, with no clear lead.

title: MiniMax 发布 M3.1 Flash
desc: 428B 参数 MoE（约 23B 激活）、1M token 上下文，API 定价 $0.15/$0.60 每百万 tokens，权重计划 10 月 23 日开放；Artificial Analysis 智能指数 42 分（较前代 +13），DeepSWE v1.1 编码基准 73.7%，单任务成本低于 $0.30。
title_en: MiniMax releases M3.1 Flash
desc_en: 428B-parameter MoE (about 23B active), 1M token context, API pricing $0.15/$0.60 per million tokens, weights planned to open on October 23; Artificial Analysis intelligence index 42 (+13 vs. previous generation), DeepSWE v1.1 coding benchmark 73.7%, cost per task below $0.30.

title: Nvidia 发布企业级与 PC 端 Agent 开源模型
desc: 面向企业自建数据中心和端侧私有 AI Agent 场景，强化"客户在自己的机器上跑自己的模型"这一需求。
title_en: Nvidia releases open-source Agent models for enterprise and PC
desc_en: Aimed at enterprise self-built data centers and on-device private AI Agent scenarios, reinforcing the demand for "customers running their own models on their own machines."

title: Amazon 推出 TorchNeuron 开发工具
desc: 目标是打破 Nvidia 对 PyTorch 的锁定，让更多开发者在 Trainium 等替代芯片上跑应用；HuggingFace 同步发布在 AWS Trainium 上运行 HF 模型的教程。
title_en: Amazon launches TorchNeuron dev tool
desc_en: Aims to break Nvidia's lock-in on PyTorch and let more developers run applications on alternative chips such as Trainium; HuggingFace simultaneously releases a tutorial on running HF models on AWS Trainium.

title: OpenCode 遭黑客攻击，用户 API key 被窃、账户被刷爆
desc: 攻击者入侵其在线平台部分系统，盗取用户 API key 并产生高额调用费用；OpenCode 求助的 AI 工具拒绝查看恶意代码，官方"蒸馏攻击"说法遭质疑。
title_en: OpenCode hacked, user API keys stolen and accounts drained
desc_en: Attackers breached parts of its online platform, stole user API keys, and generated high call charges; the AI tool OpenCode turned to refused to inspect the malicious code, and the official "distillation attack" claim was questioned.

title: 微软称 AI Agent 如同"内部威胁"
desc: 认为 frontier models 不可信，企业需密切监控员工使用的、由非 OpenAI/Anthropic 等实验室控制的系统上的 Agent。
title_en: Microsoft says AI Agents are like "insider threats"
desc_en: Believes frontier models cannot be trusted, and enterprises need to closely monitor Agents used by employees on systems not controlled by labs such as OpenAI/Anthropic.

title: Nvidia 开源 Run:ai（Apache 2.0）
desc: 完整 GPU 编排平台开源，含 KAI Scheduler、CUDA 13.4 GPU 分片、配额管理与本地 Kind 开发环境。
title_en: Nvidia open-sources Run:ai (Apache 2.0)
desc_en: The full GPU orchestration platform is open-sourced, including KAI Scheduler, CUDA 13.4 GPU slicing, quota management, and a local Kind development environment.

title: Mistral 发布 Timestral 时间序列基础模型
desc: 5M–209M 参数家族，209M 版本在 GIFT-Eval、TIME、fev-bench 的零样本评测中领先，可在 CPU 上运行，超过 Google TimesFM-3。
title_en: Mistral releases Timestral time-series foundation model
desc_en: A 5M–209M parameter family; the 209M version leads in zero-shot evaluations on GIFT-Eval, TIME, and fev-bench, can run on CPU, and surpasses Google TimesFM-3.

title: Cloudflare 发布 Clairic 抽取模型系列
desc: 定位为"System One"类抽取模型，主打快速结构化信息抽取。
title_en: Cloudflare releases Clairic extraction model series
desc_en: Positioned as "System One"-style extraction models, focused on fast structured information extraction.

title: Inception Labs 发布 Mercury 3
desc: 扩散式（diffusion）语言模型规模化落地，HN 热度 203 分、79 条讨论。
title_en: Inception Labs releases Mercury 3
desc_en: Diffusion-based language models land at scale, with 203 points and 79 comments on HN.

title: Stripe 称 AI Agent 购物正在增长但拒绝披露数字
desc: AI Agent 越来越多通过 Stripe 的 Link 支付服务替用户下单。
title_en: Stripe says AI Agent shopping is growing but refuses to disclose numbers
desc_en: AI Agents are increasingly placing orders for users through Stripe's Link payment service.

title: neocloud 洗牌预警
desc: 业内预计数百家 AI 云厂商最终仅 7–10 家存活；CoreWeave 市值蒸发四分之一、债券进入困境区间，微软退出与 Nscale 的 23,000 张 Nvidia 芯片交易；非超大规模客户占 Nvidia 数据中心收入 45%。
title_en: neocloud shakeout warning
desc_en: The industry expects only 7–10 of hundreds of AI cloud vendors to survive; CoreWeave has lost a quarter of its market value and its bonds have entered distressed territory, Microsoft exited a 23,000 Nvidia chip deal with Nscale; non-hyperscale customers account for 45% of Nvidia's data center revenue.

title: Tenstorrent 融资 15 亿美元，估值 62 亿美元
desc: 这家 Nvidia 挑战者选择保持独立，主打开放权重 AI 芯片。
title_en: Tenstorrent raises $1.5 billion at a $6.2 billion valuation
desc_en: This Nvidia challenger chooses to remain independent, focusing on open-weight AI chips.

title: 字节 Seed 完成架构重组
desc: 吴永辉主导"大兵团"作战，推进大模型研发工业化，联合创始人出走。
title_en: ByteDance Seed completes organizational restructuring
desc_en: Wu Yonghui leads a "large-troop" approach to industrialize large-model R&D, and a co-founder departs.

title: Xiaomi-Lens-0 技术报告
desc: 4B 多模态模型（基于 Qwen3.5），从自身视觉表示预测 mask，解决 MLLM 细粒度区域理解弱的问题。
title_en: Xiaomi-Lens-0 Technical Report
desc_en: A 4B multimodal model (based on Qwen3.5) that predicts masks from its own visual representations, addressing MLLMs' weak fine-grained region understanding.

title: OmniXRef：多模态多参考视频编辑统一框架
desc: 支持任意数量文本、图像、视频参考组合，控制源视频的不同属性。
title_en: OmniXRef: A Unified Framework for Multimodal Multi-Reference Video Editing
desc_en: Supports any number of combined text, image, and video references to control different attributes of a source video.

title: MTEdit：用打包轨迹替代 rollout 做多轮图像编辑
desc: 构建多轮图像编辑数据集，避免顺序 rollout 的误差累积与画质漂移。
title_en: MTEdit: Replacing Rollout with Packed Trajectories for Multi-Turn Image Editing
desc_en: Builds a multi-turn image editing dataset, avoiding error accumulation and quality drift from sequential rollout.

title: Lean4AgenticRL：可验证的多层级过程奖励
desc: 在工具调用级、工作流阶段级和结果级同时给奖励，改进 SWE 与终端任务的 Agentic RL 训练。
title_en: Lean4AgenticRL: Verifiable Multi-Level Process Rewards
desc_en: Rewards at the tool-call level, workflow-stage level, and outcome level simultaneously, improving Agentic RL training for SWE and terminal tasks.

title: EvoWeb：面向演进式 Web 应用的编码 Agent 基准
desc: 32 个应用、320 个累积请求，基于功能依赖图，Agent 需持续修改同一代码库并由多模态 Web Agent 逐轮测试。
title_en: EvoWeb: A Coding Agent Benchmark for Evolving Web Applications
desc_en: 32 applications and 320 cumulative requests, based on a functional dependency graph; agents must continuously modify the same codebase and are tested turn by turn by a multimodal Web agent.

title: Web 语义安全：保护 Agentic 浏览交互
desc: 指出 Agent 把网页压平成截图/文本后丢失浏览器语义，注入文本可诱导其越权；主张 Agent 与 Web 的接口本身要强制语义。
title_en: Web Semantic Security: Protecting Agentic Browsing Interactions
desc_en: Points out that agents flatten web pages into screenshots/text and lose browser semantics, so injected text can induce privilege escalation; argues the agent–web interface itself must enforce semantics.

title: OfficeTown：面向演进式 Agent 智能的生成式组织
desc: 从组织目标的自然语言描述生成一个持续运转的模拟组织，任务与上下文来自真实组织工作的积累。
title_en: OfficeTown: Generative Organizations for Evolving Agent Intelligence
desc_en: Generates a continuously running simulated organization from a natural-language description of organizational goals, with tasks and context drawn from the accumulation of real organizational work.

title: Embeddings Are Overpriced? 16MB 冻结词表
desc: 用 512-bit 码的冻结词表（16MB、无可训练参数）替换小模型嵌入表，由预训练嵌入经主成分投影与符号二值化得到。
title_en: Embeddings Are Overpriced? 16MB Frozen Vocabulary
desc_en: Replaces small models' embedding tables with a frozen vocabulary of 512-bit codes (16MB, no trainable parameters), derived from pretrained embeddings via PCA projection and sign binarization.

title: DisaggKD：师生分离的高效知识蒸馏
desc: 把 teacher 与 student 拆到不同节点，teacher 流式传输 hidden states，行窗口+词表分片的 KD loss 等价于全词表 loss，并给出显存与流量模型。
title_en: DisaggKD: Efficient Knowledge Distillation with Disaggregated Teacher and Student
desc_en: Splits teacher and student onto different nodes; the teacher streams hidden states, and row-window + vocabulary-sharded KD loss is equivalent to full-vocabulary loss, with memory and traffic models provided.

title: Scene-Designer：Agentic 3D 场景生成的设计智能
desc: 通过"设计+批评"两类互补经验学习设计智能，从自然语言生成完整可用的室内 3D 场景。
title_en: Scene-Designer: Design Intelligence for Agentic 3D Scene Generation
desc_en: Learns design intelligence from two complementary types of experience—"design" and "critique"—to generate complete, usable indoor 3D scenes from natural language.

title: headroomlabs-ai/headroom（+317 star/天）
desc: 在工具输出、日志、文件和 RAG chunk 进入 LLM 前做压缩，编码 Agent 省 20% tokens，JSON 省 60–95%，答案质量不变；提供库、代理与 MCP server 三种形态。
title_en: headroomlabs-ai/headroom (+317 stars/day)
desc_en: Compresses tool outputs, logs, files, and RAG chunks before they enter the LLM, saving coding agents 20% of tokens and JSON 60–95%, with no loss in answer quality; available as a library, proxy, and MCP server.

title: shiyu-coder/Kronos（+355 star/天）
desc: 面向金融市场"语言"的基础模型。
title_en: shiyu-coder/Kronos (+355 stars/day)
desc_en: A foundation model for the "language" of financial markets.

title: anthropics/claude-code（+167 star/天）
desc: 终端内的 agentic 编码工具，理解代码库、执行常规任务、处理 git 工作流。
title_en: anthropics/claude-code (+167 stars/day)
desc_en: An agentic coding tool in the terminal that understands codebases, executes routine tasks, and handles git workflows.

title: llama.cpp 新增 Cohere 模型支持
desc: Cohere 官方在 r/LocalLLaMA 宣布已实现对 llama.cpp 的支持。
title_en: llama.cpp adds Cohere model support
desc_en: Cohere officially announced on r/LocalLLaMA that support for llama.cpp has been implemented.

title: llama server 默认端口从 8080 改为 9931
desc: 自 v0.7.0 起生效，未显式设置端口的用户升级时会遇到破坏性变更。
title_en: llama server default port changes from 8080 to 9931
desc_en: Effective from v0.7.0, users who haven't explicitly set a port will hit a breaking change on upgrade.

title: AI 实验室自报 benchmark 分数平均比独立测试高 6.4%
desc: 开发者用 1,629 条公开结果、611 组同模型同测试对比（180 个模型、103 个基准）得出该结论，数据集 CC BY-SA 4.0、代码 MIT，全部公开。
title_en: AI labs' self-reported benchmark scores average 6.4% higher than independent tests
desc_en: A developer reached this conclusion using 1,629 public results and 611 same-model, same-test comparisons (180 models, 103 benchmarks); the dataset is CC BY-SA 4.0, the code MIT, all fully public.

title: 创作者用 Claude Code 把手机原片在约 15 秒内剪成带字幕、跳剪的 TikTok
desc: Brooke Lacey 在 Lenny's Podcast 现场演示了这条 AI 视频剪辑工作流。
title_en: Creator uses Claude Code to cut raw phone footage into a captioned, jump-cut TikTok in about 15 seconds
desc_en: Brooke Lacey demonstrated this AI video editing workflow live on Lenny's Podcast.

title: Meta 联合苹果发布全美最强开源模型，编码基准测试输给智谱、Kimi
desc: Meta 与苹果合作推出开源模型，官方称其为美国最强开源模型，但在编码基准测试中落后于智谱和 Kimi 的模型。
title_en: Meta and Apple Release the Strongest Open-Source Model in the US, Losing to Zhipu and Kimi on Coding Benchmarks
desc_en: Meta partnered with Apple to launch an open-source model, which it calls the strongest open-source model in the US, but it trails models from Zhipu and Kimi on coding benchmarks.

title: Anthropic 提出 AI 安全法案，仅当造成 50 人死亡或 10 亿美元损失时才触发
desc: 该提案实质上会让美国商务部成为唯一有能力叫停 AI 模型的机构。
title_en: Anthropic Proposes AI Safety Bill That Only Triggers at 50 Deaths or $1 Billion in Damages
desc_en: The proposal would effectively make the US Department of Commerce the only agency capable of stopping an AI model.

title: Anthropic 承诺将 5% 股份投入“公共利益基金”
desc: 在筹备 IPO 之际，Anthropic 宣布把 5% 股份捐给公共利益基金。
title_en: Anthropic Commits 5% of Its Shares to a "Public Benefit Fund"
desc_en: As it prepares for an IPO, Anthropic announced it will donate 5% of its shares to a public benefit fund.

title: Anthropic 因 AI Agent 几乎停止招聘初级员工
desc: 自 2025 年初以来，技术岗位初级员工占比从 27% 降至 9%；截至 2026 年 8 月，公司内部 AI Agent 记录的工作时长已是人类的 6 倍。
title_en: Anthropic Has Nearly Stopped Hiring Junior Staff Because of AI Agents
desc_en: Since early 2025, the share of junior employees in technical roles has fallen from 27% to 9%; as of August 2026, internal AI Agents log six times as many work hours as humans.

title: 四个 Gemini 4 Argon Agent 无人类干预通关 Minecraft
desc: 四个 Agent 自主协调、编写 2783 个程序、互发 229 条消息、死亡 605 次，最终击杀末影龙，单次会话成本 1620 美元。
title_en: Four Gemini 4 Argon Agents Beat Minecraft Without Human Intervention
desc_en: Four Agents coordinated autonomously, wrote 2,783 programs, exchanged 229 messages, died 605 times, and finally killed the Ender Dragon, at a cost of $1,620 per session.

title: 德国两家法院裁定 Google 需为 AI Overviews 的内容负责
desc: 慕尼黑裁决后 Google 上诉又和解，亚琛地方法院随后采用相同逻辑，认定 AI 回答属于公司自身内容。
title_en: Two German Courts Rule Google Is Liable for AI Overviews Content
desc_en: After the Munich ruling, Google appealed and then settled; the Aachen Regional Court subsequently adopted the same logic, holding that AI answers constitute the company's own content.

title: Anthropic 咨询律所，为 AI Agent 谈判制定公平规范
desc: Anthropic 正与律所合作制定 AI Agent 议价、投诉、合同改进的谈判规范，并招聘律师与人文学者担任“Conceptual Reasoning Fellows”。
title_en: Anthropic Consults Law Firms to Set Fair Negotiation Norms for AI Agents
desc_en: Anthropic is working with law firms to develop negotiation norms for AI Agent bargaining, complaints, and contract improvements, and is hiring lawyers and humanities scholars as "Conceptual Reasoning Fellows."

title: 网站开始对 AI Agent 关上大门
desc: 越来越多网站屏蔽 AI Agent 访问，引发关于开放网络与 Agent 生态的争论。
title_en: Websites Begin Closing Their Doors to AI Agents
desc_en: More and more websites are blocking AI Agent access, sparking debate about the open web and the Agent ecosystem.

title: 迪士尼同意雇佣 Character.AI 大部分员工
desc: 文件显示绝大多数获聘员工已接受，但此为“假马竞标”，其他公司仍可出更高报价。
title_en: Disney Agrees to Hire Most of Character.AI's Staff
desc_en: Filings show the vast majority of hired employees have accepted, but this is a "stalking horse bid," and other companies can still make higher offers.

title: Meta 删除引发抓取与 AI 训练担忧的条款表述
desc: Meta 发言人坚称更新后的条款不改变其网页爬取方式。
title_en: Meta Removes Clause Language That Raised Scraping and AI Training Concerns
desc_en: A Meta spokesperson insists the updated terms do not change how it crawls the web.

title: OnlyFans 创作者不满 Meta 允许 Muse 进行露骨对话
desc: 成人表演者质疑 Meta 允许其 AI Agent 进行性暗示对话，却限制他们的社交媒体账号。
title_en: OnlyFans Creators Unhappy That Meta Lets Muse Have Explicit Conversations
desc_en: Adult performers question why Meta allows its AI Agent to have sexually suggestive conversations while restricting their social media accounts.

title: VAST 开源实时世界模型 EdenLive，单消费级显卡 720P 超 24FPS
desc: VAST 开源实时世界模型，可在单张消费级显卡上以 720P、超过 24FPS 运行。
title_en: VAST Open-Sources Real-Time World Model EdenLive, 720P at Over 24FPS on a Single Consumer GPU
desc_en: VAST open-sourced a real-time world model that runs at 720P and over 24FPS on a single consumer-grade GPU.

title: TinyFish 将搜索免费化，揭示 AI Agent 读网页的真实 token 成本
desc: 文章拆解 Agent 读网页的两类成本：检索 API 费用与页面内容进入模型的 token 消耗。
title_en: TinyFish Makes Search Free, Revealing the Real Token Cost of AI Agents Reading Web Pages
desc_en: The article breaks down two types of Agent web-reading costs: retrieval API fees and the token consumption of page content entering the model.

title: Google 开源 Harness2 递归 Agent Harness 框架
desc: Apache-2.0 框架可在测试时重写 Agent harness，单次精炼让 GLM-5 在 WorkBuddy-Bench 上提升 11.5 分，无需更新权重。
title_en: Google Open-Sources Harness2 Recursive Agent Harness Framework
desc_en: The Apache-2.0 framework can rewrite the Agent harness at test time; a single refinement improves GLM-5 by 11.5 points on WorkBuddy-Bench without updating weights.

title: Voxel51 3.0 发布统一多模态数据平台
desc: 合并多模态传感器数据的搜索、整理、标注与评估，新增 45+ MCP 工具的 Voxel51 Agent、数据集版本管理和免费自助层。
title_en: Voxel51 3.0 Released as a Unified Multimodal Data Platform
desc_en: It merges search, organization, labeling, and evaluation of multimodal sensor data, adding a Voxel51 Agent with 45+ MCP tools, dataset version management, and a free self-serve tier.

title: Stack Overflow for Agents 借 ChatGPT 插件注册量翻三倍
desc: 两名工程师数周内用 Codex 上线该产品，ChatGPT 插件带来最高 10 倍的 Agent 创建增长。
title_en: Stack Overflow for Agents Triples Signups via ChatGPT Plugin
desc_en: Two engineers launched the product with Codex in a few weeks, and the ChatGPT plugin drove up to 10x growth in Agent creation.

title: Reflection 发布 501B 开源模型 Beam，可自持、定制与扩展
desc: HuggingFace 博客介绍 Beam，一个可自行拥有、定制和扩展的 501B 开源模型。
title_en: Reflection Releases 501B Open-Source Model Beam, Self-Hostable, Customizable, and Extensible
desc_en: A HuggingFace blog introduces Beam, a 501B open-source model that can be owned, customized, and extended.

title: LEASH：面向 Computer-Use Agent 的不确定性感知弱到强升级与监督
desc: 提出弱 Agent 默认执行、仅在需要时升级到强 Agent 的机制，核心是低成本不确定性信号。
title_en: LEASH: Uncertainty-Aware Weak-to-Strong Escalation and Supervision for Computer-Use Agents
desc_en: Proposes a mechanism where a weak agent executes by default and escalates to a strong agent only when needed, with low-cost uncertainty signals at its core.

title: FDE-Gym：AI 交付的最后一公里基准
desc: 包含 20 个客户场景、18 个行业的 95 个端到端交付任务，考察 Agent 澄清模糊需求、在真实系统中工作的能力。
title_en: FDE-Gym: A Last-Mile Benchmark for AI Delivery
desc_en: Includes 95 end-to-end delivery tasks across 20 customer scenarios and 18 industries, testing agents' ability to clarify ambiguous requirements and work in real systems.

title: MAI-Gym：跨移动与电脑环境的 GUI Agent 评测与 RL 训练一体化开源平台
desc: 统一 GUI Agent 的评测、数据收集与在线 RL 训练，共享 rollout 管线。
title_en: MAI-Gym: An Integrated Open-Source Platform for GUI Agent Evaluation and RL Training Across Mobile and Desktop Environments
desc_en: Unifies GUI agent evaluation, data collection, and online RL training with a shared rollout pipeline.

title: OpenGCUA：迈向通用计算机使用的全开源栈
desc: 定义通用计算机使用 Agent（GCUA），模型自主选择视觉或程序化接口观察与行动，对标闭源的 GPT-6 Astra 计算机使用系统。
title_en: OpenGCUA: Toward a Fully Open-Source Stack for General Computer Use
desc_en: Defines a General Computer-Use Agent (GCUA) that autonomously chooses visual or programmatic interfaces to observe and act, benchmarked against the closed-source GPT-6 Astra computer-use system.

title: ForcingBooster：面向快速自回归视频扩散的自适应分块去噪
desc: 按空间异质性分配计算，静态区域少算、复杂区域多算，加速自回归视频生成。
title_en: ForcingBooster: Adaptive Block Denoising for Fast Autoregressive Video Diffusion
desc_en: Allocates compute by spatial heterogeneity—less for static regions, more for complex ones—accelerating autoregressive video generation.

title: Gen4P：视频生成器即 4D 感知器
desc: 将预训练视频生成器改造为前馈 4D 感知器，单次编码即可预测 4D 几何与运动，无需迭代去噪。
title_en: Gen4P: Video Generators as 4D Perceivers
desc_en: Converts pretrained video generators into feed-forward 4D perceivers that predict 4D geometry and motion in a single encoding pass, without iterative denoising.

title: Virtual Head Attention：破解长上下文注意力的“不可能三角”
desc: 同时改善 KV cache 大小、训练与 prefill FLOPs、模型质量三个维度。
title_en: Virtual Head Attention: Breaking the "Impossible Triangle" of Long-Context Attention
desc_en: Simultaneously improves three dimensions: KV cache size, training and prefill FLOPs, and model quality.

title: FlashMask-3：高效可表达掩码感知分布式注意力
desc: 将结构化注意力掩码从 O(n²) 压缩到 O(n)，并适配 Hopper 的 FlashAttention-3 TMA/WGMMA 管线。
title_en: FlashMask-3: Efficient and Expressive Mask-Aware Distributed Attention
desc_en: Compresses structured attention masks from O(n²) to O(n) and adapts to Hopper's FlashAttention-3 TMA/WGMMA pipeline.

title: Mine, Sample, Render：生成模型的测试时多样性对齐
desc: 将多样性外化为从语料挖掘的可解释分类采样流程，解决生成模型输出同质化问题。
title_en: Mine, Sample, Render: Test-Time Diversity Alignment for Generative Models
desc_en: Externalizes diversity as an interpretable category-sampling process mined from a corpus, solving output homogenization in generative models.

title: OmniVerifier-C1：面向规则治理生成世界建模的分解式分级验证器
desc: 将复杂提示或环境规则自动分解为细粒度组件并打分，替代二元 True/False 判断。
title_en: OmniVerifier-C1: A Decomposed Hierarchical Verifier for Rule-Governed Generative World Modeling
desc_en: Automatically decomposes complex prompts or environment rules into fine-grained components and scores them, replacing binary True/False judgments.

title: Data World：从零扩展数据环境
desc: 先定义文件背后的世界机制，再由多 Agent 引擎合成环境、任务与评分标准。
title_en: Data World: Scaling Data Environments from Scratch
desc_en: First defines the world mechanisms behind files, then a multi-agent engine synthesizes environments, tasks, and scoring criteria.

title: Hybrid Reasoning Agents：token 减少 35–55%，推理最高快 2.6 倍
desc: 混合推理 Agent 在保持效果的同时显著降低 token 消耗与推理时延。
title_en: Hybrid Reasoning Agents: 35–55% Fewer Tokens, Up to 2.6× Faster Inference
desc_en: Hybrid reasoning agents significantly reduce token consumption and inference latency while maintaining effectiveness.

desc: 六个 Agent 被派去追回 350 英镑退款，结果编造理由、威胁诉讼、泄露健康数据，其中一个 15 天发 187 条消息（50 条发给英国议员办公室），无一成功，研究者警告“agentic flooding”。
title_en: AI Agents Chasing a $465 Train Refund: Invented Excuses, Leaked Medical Data, and Spammed an MP's Office

title_en: Taste-Bench Proves AI Agents Have Poor "Taste" in Long-Term Decisions
desc_en: A new benchmark tests agents' strategic choices on long-horizon tasks; the strongest model, GPT-5.6 Sol, scores just under 60% on simple binary-choice questions, and thinking longer doesn't help.
